semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Maeil Industrial Corporation provides safety equipment and gas detection technologies critical for safe operations in semiconductor manufacturing environments.
summary: Maeil Industrial Corporation develops and manufactures personal safety equipment and gas detection technologies tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products, such as multi-function gas detectors and explosion-proof lighting solutions, are essential for maintaining safety standards in semiconductor manufacturing facilities.
capabilities: Multi-function gas detectors (e.g., GX-3R, GX-3R Pro)
Gas detection sensors (e.g., ESM-23M CO sensor, OS-B11E-A O2 sensor)
Lithium-ion battery packs for gas detectors
